mapper.select: SELECT num, id, name, subject, content, regist_day AS registDay, hit, ip FROM board ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT num, id, name, subject, content, regist_day AS registDay, hit, ip FROM board WHERE num = #{num}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (id, name, subject, content, regist_day, hit, ip) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{subject}, #{content}, NOW(), 0, #{ip})
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET hit = hit + 1 WHERE num = #{num}
